headline: AI Trade Is Moving From Nvidia To The Bond Market
summary: Nvidia, Oracle, Meta are turning to debt markets to fund AI infrastructure. The next phase of the AI boom may belong to lenders and bond investors.

headline: OpenAI, Anthropic IPOs Spark Battle Between Goldman And Morgan Stanley
summary: Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are organizing separate banking teams to work on potential stock market debuts by OpenAI and Anthropic.
